title: Package one build log
task: Create support.tar.gz with only the file reports/build log.txt. Store that member as build log.txt without the reports/ prefix. Save the member listing to member.txt and the archived log’s text to extracted.txt. Leave the starter files in place.
hints: Inspect the reports directory with ls and identify the exact file to include.
Use tar -C reports to select an input relative to reports/. Quote the member filename.
Use tar -tzf to list and tar -xOzf to read the member to stdout. Redirect each command to its own report.

checks.label: The archive contains only the intended build log and starter inputs are unchanged
checks.feedback: Use -C reports before the member name to avoid adding the directory prefix.

checks.label: The archive listing records the exact member name
checks.feedback: Save tar -tzf output and confirm there is just one line.

checks.label: The archived evidence was read back intact
checks.feedback: Use uppercase -O to emit the archived file without overwriting it.

demo.explanation: -C changes where tar finds its following inputs. The archive stores the member without the reports prefix.
-O sends the contents to stdout so you can inspect or redirect them.
